reference.pathophysiology: Retroviral CD4 killing stages disease by counts from thrush and TB through PCP and toxo to crypto and CMV; integrase ART rebuilds immunity while cotrimoxazole tiers prevent, IRIS unmasks with early starts, and condoms with PrEP PEP and PMTCT block spread.
additionalDifferentials: TB versus lymphoma versus metabolic versus CMV by granulomas clonality drugs and PCR
PCP versus TB versus bacterial by dry GeneXpert and lobar signs
Toxo versus lymphoma versus PML by rings enhancement and JJV
